Jiangsu was the best performing team in the medal table, taking seven gold medals and seventeen medals overall.
Shandong equalled that haul, but had six golds.
The hosts Liaoning had the largest total, with 18 medals, although only two of these were gold.
Guangdong, Shanghai and Beijing each took four golds in the athletics competition.
Twenty-eight teams reached the medal table.
Zhang Peimeng won two of Beijing's four gold medals.
Shot put winner Gong Lijiao was one of three medallists for Hebei.
